paragraph: [material] walling in [element_type], bedded and jointed in cement mortar (1:4), to [location]; including all bonding, reinforcement, movement joints and [fixings]; rendered both faces in cement-sand (1:4) and finished to [standard].
notes: Kibale NP. Replaces the generic wall template so the bill reads as a Ugandan blockwork description rather than a UK cavity-wall one.

paragraph: Reinforced concrete retaining wall, [element_type], to [location]; including formwork to both faces, reinforcement, construction joints, granular drainage layer, weepholes and tanking to the retained face; concrete [concrete_spec].
notes: The 27.75 m fall makes retaining a major measured item; it must not read as ordinary walling.

paragraph: Reinforced concrete ground slab [element_type] to [location]; laid on compacted hardcore filling blinded with sand, on 1000 gauge damp-proof membrane; including formwork to edges, reinforcement and power-float finish; concrete [concrete_spec].
Cement and sand screed (1:4), [element_type] thick, to [location]; laid on prepared concrete base, levelled and laid to falls where indicated, floated to receive [finish].
notes: Screed has no parameter, no formula and no corporate template anywhere in STINGTOOLS. This template and the kbl-floor-screed takeoff rule are the only route it has into the bill.

paragraph: [material] flooring to [location]; laid on prepared screed in approved adhesive, including all cutting, borders, thresholds and beads; sanded, sealed and finished to [standard].
notes: Covers the 'timber panquette ff' annotation on the architect's plans. Confirm the spelling with the architect — RFI-01.

paragraph: Makuti thatch roof covering, [element_type] thick, to [location]; laid to falls on treated timber purlins at centres as detailed, including ridging, eaves dressing, verge treatment, tying and all fixings; complete to [standard].
notes: Pending RFI-03 — the roof design does not exist in the information issued. Revise once it does.

paragraph: [material] roof sheeting to [location]; fixed to timber purlins with approved fixings and washers, including ridge, barge and eaves flashings, laps and sealants; complete to [standard].
notes: Alternative to thatch. The library names iron sheets by gauge — IRON SHEET 28 GAUGE 0.9MM — which reads correctly in a Ugandan bill.

paragraph: [material] ceiling to [location]; fixed to treated timber brandering at centres as detailed, including all trims, cornices and access panels; finished to [standard].
[door_type] door, [element_type], to [location]; including frame, architraves, ironmongery, and all fixings; hung, adjusted and finished to [standard].
notes: door_type resolves from the type name, so name the types DR-D2-PVO-900x2100 and the architect's own code carries straight into the bill.

paragraph: [window_type] window, [element_type], to [location]; including frame, glazing [glass_spec], ironmongery, sills and all fixings; fitted, adjusted and finished to [standard].

[manufacturer] [model] [element_type] to [location]; including all brackets, fixings, traps, waste and supply connections; jointed to services, tested and left in working order; complete to [standard].

Site formation to [location]; excavate to reduce levels, cart away surplus, and deposit, level and compact fill in layers not exceeding 225 mm to form platforms as detailed; including all trimming of slopes and temporary support.
notes: Bulk earthworks on a 27.75 m fall. Reconcile the modelled volume against the graded-region Cut/Fill schedule before issue — nothing in STINGTOOLS reads those properties (gap B-2).
